data.body: **[P2] Preserve the duplicate-exporter invariant after validation.** This check observes the caller-owned mutable `exporters` list only once. A caller can construct a valid config, append an already-present exporter afterward, and then pass it to `workflow_insight`; the plugin copies the duplicates and creates two workers that concurrently call the same exporter. Snapshot exporters into an immutable collection during `__post_init__`, or revalidate the copied list in `WorkflowInsightPlugin.__init__`, and add a post-construction mutation test.
